enfoque_h2: Cómo llevamos la IA a producción
How we take AI to production

p: Una prueba acotada con tus datos reales para medir si funciona antes de invertir en todo el sistema.
A scoped test on your real data to measure whether it works before you invest in the full system.
Calculamos cuánto cuesta cada consulta y ponemos límites por usuario. Las llaves viven en el servidor, nunca en la app.

We send only what's needed and, when possible, the AI runs on the device. We have worked with sensitive clinical data on IRISA.
Antes de lanzar acordamos cómo se mide que la IA acierta, y lo seguimos midiendo después.
Before launch we agree on how to measure whether the AI gets it right, and we keep measuring afterwards.

Start with a process that costs hours of manual work today: entering documents, sorting requests, answering common questions or reviewing photos. In the free first call we look at where AI saves work and where it isn't worth it.
